title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans' Memorial Coliseum on 1982-09-23

ai_review.summary: Audience recording captures a high‑energy early‑80s Dead show with standout Althea, Rooster, Throwing Stones and Wheel, while delivering solid sound despite a slightly rough first set.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers a lively snapshot of the band in their early‑80s stride – the crowd is clearly into it and the audience mix holds up well enough to let the excitement shine through. Highlights include a fiery Althea, scorching Rooster, an unforgettable Throwing Stones debut, and a soaring Wheel/Other One sequence, while the opening Alabama shows a bit of looseness that smooths out as the night progresses.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars, praising its energy and many standout songs; recording quality is consistently described as good to excellent, leading to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and consistent for an audience tape; a few reviewers note slight muddiness at the very start but overall the mix captures crowd energy and instrument balance well.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A rough opening with a loose Alabama gives way to tighter playing; the first set builds momentum and the second set delivers strong jams, especially after the post‑drum segment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: High‑voltage start on Alabama, scorching solo during Sailor, emotive vocal on Baby Blue; noted for “eating their Wheaties” during the drums.
band_member_comments.Bob: Slide guitar and vocals shine on Rooster; participates in the post‑drum jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboardist) adds vocal flair on Johnny B. Goode; overall keyboard work supports the jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: Post‑drum segment praised as “rhythm devils”; drums drive the second‑set high points, especially during The Wheel and Other One.
